instruction: Open the Driver License Eligibility Requirements page on the Virginia DMV website.

llm_judge_reasons: The getter 'active_url_from_accessTree' correctly extracts the active tab URL from Chrome's accessibility tree, which is the right state to verify page navigation.

The metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' correctly handles the 'rule' type: when expected.type='rule', the framework passes config['rules'] directly as the 'rules' parameter, and the function accesses rules['expected'] directly — correct parameter handling.
The regex pattern '^https://(www\.)?dmv\.virginia\.gov/licenses-ids/license/applying/eligibility' correctly matches the known URL of the Driver License Eligibility Requirements page.
The instruction has a single verifiable requirement (navigating to the specific page), and the evaluator fully covers it via the URL pattern check.
No postconfig is needed since URL state is always accessible without reopening dialogs.
